::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Decr 15th [1869]  
**From:** “Monthly Packet” 6, Paternoster Row, London, E.C.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Mrs Mercier](people/person_990.qmd),
Your [recollections](other_books/otherbook_562.qmd) of [Mr Peabody](people/person_990.qmd) are very touching, and I hope they will appear in February - January is pretty well done for! I am sorry for the blunder about [Christabel](other_books/otherbook_563.qmd), it came of lending the book and trusting to memory[^1]

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Mercier's novel *Christabel Hope, or, The Beginnings of Life* (London, Warne 1869) was noticed in ‘Hints on Reading’ *MP* 8 (December 1869) 619 as *Christabel Ross*.
